def transform(grid):
    """Copy the marked shape to every translation fully covered by zeros."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = min((value for value in counts if value != background), key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    if not points:
        return out
    top, left = min(r for r, _ in points), min(c for _, c in points)
    shape = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    sh = max(r for r, _ in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for _, c in shape) + 1
    for r in range(h - sh + 1):
        for c in range(w - sw + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
